other_conditions: Applicant must be a native resident student of Chhattisgarh
Applicant must be currently studying in a recognized engineering college in Chhattisgarh
Applicant must be pursuing an engineering degree course
Students must have passed 10th and 12th standards with at least 60 % marks from any recognized institution in Chhattisgarh
Diploma holders admitted to the second year of B.E. must have passed the final year diploma exam with at least 60 % marks
No student will receive more than one scholarship at the same time without special government approval
Students may continue receiving the scholarship if they have a fee concession from their institution
Only one concession is allowed: a student receiving any scholarship may do part‑time work while regularly studying
Children of permanent government employees of Chhattisgarh on deputation to the Government of India or another state government are exempted from the qualification condition
Students in full‑time employment are not eligible for the scholarship
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month for eligible engineering students (first year or second‑year lateral entry)
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
